name: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Toast
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2–4 tbsp peanut butter, smooth or crunchy

steps: Toast the bread on both sides in a toaster oven, using the broiler setting.
Smear the peanut butter on the bread.
Sprinkle chocolate chips lightly (or heavily, if you want!) over the peanut butter.
Put the toast back under the broiler for about 20 seconds to melt the chocolate.
